description: This file contains a series of shell script tests for Git rebase functionality, including setup, various rebase scenarios, error handling, and edge cases.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with specified message and files.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that a command must fail.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test clock for timestamp purposes.

methods.name: test_might_fail
methods.description: Runs a command that may fail without failing the test.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in output.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
